task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, try to travel west. After that, venture west. And then, head south. Once you accomplish that, recover the laptop from the floor of the bedchamber. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
Of every study you could have walked into, you had to show up in a typical one.



You need an unguarded exit? You should try going west.

thought: I should try to travel west as the first step.
feedback:
Look around you. Take it all in. It's not every day someone gets to be in a spare room.



There is an unblocked exit to the east. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
